title: Troubleshooting 101
summary: What to do when things go wrong.
objectives: Understand the concept of a restart

steps.boltSpeech: Sometimes, computers stop working right. Don't panic!

content.text: When a computer freezes or something won't turn on, we can Troubleshoot to fix it.

points.text: Step 1: Check the cables. Is it plugged in?
Step 2: Restart. Turning it off and on again fixes most problems!
Step 3: Ask for help from a teacher or parent.

questions.prompt: Your mouse is not moving the pointer on the screen. What is the FIRST thing you should check?

options.label: Check if the mouse cable is plugged in.

questions.prompt: The computer is completely frozen and nothing is clicking. What is the best troubleshooting step?

points.text: You know how to type on the home row.
You know how to be safe online and fix basic problems!

content.message: Congratulations! You have completed the Tech Champions track!
